initial_prompt:

Image 2 is the character costume and SIZE authority. Image 3 is only the standing size comparison. Replace Lee Sin in all nine frames with Shen from image 2.
Output 1440x1440, nine 480x480 cells, same pure #00FF00 green background, no grid lines text or labels. The logical sheet is 180x180 pixels magnified 8x nearest-neighbor, each cell60x60 logical pixels. One uniform hard square pixel grid, dark outline 1 logical pixel, no antialiasing gradients blur or fine-detail subpixels. Every pixel block is 8x8 output pixels.
Shen hood crown-to-ground is about40 logical pixels, sword pommel-to-ground46, versus Lee Sin36. KEEP original foot heights and horizontal torso positions; grow head and torso upwards. Maintain the broad anatomy of image2, NEVER skinny legs or small boots. Both hands swing reciprocally with running, elbows bent as in image1.
This is a RESKIN of the EXACT existing 9 frame action skeleton: legs cross as they alternate, front leg extends and lands while trailing leg bends back/up, legs pass each other in middle cycle; alternate which leg is in front, preserve original knee/ankle timing. Do not replace with 9 standing poses or repeated wide V legs. Frame1 wide planted stride, frames2-3 right/front foot extended and left foot raised trailing; frames4-6 legs pass underneath crossing tightly, frames7-9 opposite stride opening, following each individual source silhouette. Body subtly bobs and leans forward, hands counter-swing. Keep exactly9 complete sprites and plenty room above each hood/pommel. Color and pixel rendering must match image2 exactly.
